provider.description: Provider that produced this decision log (for example gemini, claude, codex, openclaw).

sessionId.description: The agent run or OpenClaw session identifier.

agentId.description: The unique agent (or role) making the decision.

eventType.description: The type of decision event (for example PR_APPROVAL, MERGE_GATE, DEPLOY_DECISION).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the decision was made.

prompt.description: Canonical prompt that drove the decision.

output.description: Decision output (for example APPROVE, REJECT, EXECUTE).

modelVersion.description: Model identifier/version used to generate the decision.

nonce.description: Random 32-byte hex nonce used in commit/reveal hashing.

generationConfig.description: Optional provider generation settings used to produce the output.

metadata.description: Optional context map (PR number, branch, SHA, test summaries, provider metadata).
